ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Hyper-V Cmdlets
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may carry out malicious operations using a virtual instance to avoid detection Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-VM.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-VMFirmware.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Start\\-VM.*"))
